# QuranWall

> QuranWall is an iOS app, free to download with optional in-app subscription plans, that transforms the iPhone lock screen into a daily source of Quran, prayer, and Muslim inspiration. It uses the iOS wallpaper system and Focus modes (iOS 16+) to surface Quran verses every time you pick up your phone.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: iOS app for daily Quran verses on the iPhone lock screen
- **Platform**: iPhone (iOS 15.0 or later per the App Store listing; lock screen widgets and per-screen wallpapers need iOS 16)
- **Price**: Free download with optional premium plans
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/quran-verse-lock-screen/id6781802080?pt=128303795&ct=qw-web-llms&mt=8
- **Website**: https://quranwall.com
- **Author / Founder**: Karol Billik
- **Built by**: karchi. (https://www.karchi.xyz/)
- **Contact**: iosnotewall@gmail.com
- **Minimum iOS**: 15.0 (App Store listing)
- **Pricing**: Free to download, with in-app subscription plans (weekly and yearly billing periods in the App Store listing). Prices and any free-trial or introductory offer are shown in the App Store before you pay, in your local currency, and change over time, so this file states none.

## Pricing

- Download: free
- Premium: auto-renewing in-app subscription plans, weekly and yearly billing periods (per the App Store listing)

QuranWall states no prices here. The App Store shows the exact price, billing period and any free-trial or introductory offer before you pay, in your local currency, and these vary by region and over time. Payment processing is handled by RevenueCat; QuranWall does not store card details.

## How it works

QuranWall delivers Quran to the most-seen surface on a smartphone, the lock screen, through two complementary methods:
1. **Wallpapers**: A curated rotating set of verse-styled wallpapers, automatically installed via iOS Focus modes.
2. **Widgets**: Native iOS widgets that display a fresh verse on the lock screen each day, with packs organized by theme (Anxiety, Patience, Gratitude, Mercy, etc.).

## What makes it different

- **Single-purpose**: Most Muslim apps try to do everything. QuranWall does one thing, Quran on the lock screen, and does it well.
- **Frictionless setup**: A 60-second onboarding installs the lock screen automatically; no manual wallpaper export.
- **Focus mode integration**: Pairs with iOS Focus to make Quiet Time a one-tap retreat from notifications.
- **Designed for daily reach**: Uses spaced repetition through rotating verses rather than asking users to remember to open another app.
